content: Satu̱choda Pyítrubay Juánbatya japuvedabay tuunu
Nanuniquejada jsa̱ju̱ rimyu̱ti̱jada caserdótevyeda variy, Ju̱denu nijyu̱ jachipiya̱jo nutyityu̱ta, Saadusévuvedata jarye.
Riñique̱tta̱da varirya jiryatiy nanudatyanunu̱yada Pyítruju̱be, Juánta daryaju̱ riy nijya̱nvay. Satu̱chunu̱yada Pyítrubay daryaju̱ ruuva: “Jesúsmusiy vu̱ryi jrirya diibyimusiy mi̱sa̱da.”
Rureda ji̱ta variñada Pyítruju̱be, Juánbatya. Rityanuvu̱doda variñada rata̱rimyusijyu̱ nupocu rorivyimu, jidyenuma ravicha̱da daryaju̱ varidye.
Ti̱quitya tuva̱chunu̱yada daryaju̱ ramu nanuniquejada. Vadujyuu vichanu̱yada rajuu, tadajyo vara̱nca tuunudera rivyichanu̱yada daryaju̱.
Ratarya rundamu ji̱ta riintye̱ryaniñu̱yada japuveda Jerusarí̱muyu. Jasiy rivyichanu̱yada nutyityu̱veda variy, rimyityuveda jarye, Ju̱denu niquejada datyanuvay jarye.
Jasiy savichanu̱yada Anásiy jtyati̱bay varintyi, caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱, Cayivásubay, Juánbay, Adejántrubay, satevay jarye ti̱ta̱ju̱ yisa̱ju̱.
Riñatuyada ji̱ta variñada, Pyítruju̱be Juánta, jiquebyimuju̱, ruutaja̱doda variy jasiñada: “¿Nu̱tyurata sa̱numi̱saniñi̱, nu̱tyurata? ¿Chi̱ jtyamura sa̱numi̱saniñi̱, chi̱ jtyamu?”

Samu̱chadeda Ju̱denu Jnutuni̱ Pyítrubay, su̱teda ji̱ta variy ruuva: “Temusiy jiryitaja̱nuru̱y dyetya na̱y, nijya̱nvay nutyityu̱miy, Irayénuveda rimyityumiy jarye. Jirya̱jtaja̱nute na̱cyu̱, ¿nu̱tyuramusiy saratyeje jarapu̱yani̱, nu̱tyuramusiy? ¿Chi̱na̱te mi̱saniñi̱ jiñu jarapu̱yani̱, chi̱?

Jiryedyetya̱daju̱ ra̱tu̱chu jiryivara, ti̱ta̱ju̱ Irayénuvedava jarye: Sami̱sajay jiñu vanu jarapu̱yani̱ Jesucrístu jtyamu, jiryatiy Nasaryému savichanu̱yada. Nu̱tyu ni̱day jiryeñi crusiñutintyi, Ju̱denu mi̱sanityi variy sadiijyomusiyu. Su̱tedamuju̱ saraniy jiñu vanu mi̱si̱ jiryetyuunu.

Jiñu Jesús rañi̱cha̱da ravichu̱, jirye ji̱ta roriy jvaavyedye, jiryejetya̱simya̱ni̱ javiryu̱tyasi̱, sani bamya̱ Ju̱denu rajo̱ttya̱ ravichu̱ju̱ni̱, sa̱tidye roriiy sanchara jiryoriy. Jiryatiy vuryi̱tay saroriryi, rivyicha simu tuva̱chuvay daryaju̱.
Ne yinu̱y ne ti̱ ra̱ra̱chara vuryeyada jadchiñu̱day. Ne tara jtyatara jadchiy jarichu jarijyu̱nu̱day, jiryatiy sasa̱yada Ju̱denu jiñu vanu Jesúsra, ni̱tidye ra̱ra̱chara variy vuryeyada.”

Ru̱nu̱yada ji̱ta japuveda sana̱cho̱ variy: “Nadani̱ ji̱ta si̱tenu nique jivyanu̱yadata, samiy nanudatya̱data, vu̱ñi datyi̱satya ne nanudatyara catera nu̱yada, tapi jantyuyani̱ju̱y daryaju̱ nada jiñuju̱y nijya̱mi̱ju̱y.” Rityi̱tta̱da variñada. Ridyetya̱da ji̱ta variy nadanchiy: “Jiñuju̱y Jesúsjsa̱ vichanu̱jyu̱y.”
Jiryatiy ridyiñu̱yada siva vanu mi̱sanichi̱ jityuunu, ne ru̱taryu̱yada tara variñu̱day.

Pariche ru̱pa̱jada jadchiy jityuunusiñada, Pyítruju̱be, Juánta. Jasiñuma riñiquejada nu̱ñi rijyuu yiva: “¿Nu̱tyura vurye̱chaniñada jiñuju̱y vanuju̱ñu̱day, nu̱tyura? Ne ti̱ ra̱ramicha datya̱da nadanu̱ndye, jiryatiy mityamusiy ju̱deru̱y daryaju̱ nada. Ti̱ta̱ju̱ma̱ ridyetya Jerusarí̱ ja̱nvarya, ne vana̱y nta vuryi̱tañu̱ndye: Ne nanumi̱saniy si̱tenuni̱.
Rañuma ju̱ray ju̱na̱y tu̱chodanu̱day, vurya̱jiyaro̱nu nada nañuma nique ju̱na̱ñu̱nrya Jesús jtyanu̱day.”
Jadchiy ji̱ta riñatuyada variñadantiy, ru̱bayada ji̱ta variy nana̱jisirya: “Ne sa̱na̱nique ju̱na̱ñu̱nrya Jesús jtyanu̱day, dantyamu̱y ne sa̱na̱datyanu Jesús jtyamunu̱day.”
Pyítrubay, Juánbatya nani̱mutya̱jada variryi: “Jirya̱ntya jachipiya̱ samiy, samiryavidye sa̱diy Ju̱denu vuryiva, na̱ña̱vidye siitye jiryejyu̱, varimyata Ju̱denuju̱ dyetya.
Na̱y ji̱ta ne paru̱ryu̱y riva niquejada day, jiryatiy na̱dyi riva, na̱tyuva̱chura darya niquejada.”

Riyaro̱dodivasiy, yimu̱rya̱da variñada, ru̱tamya̱tiy: “¿Ta̱raju̱ra vurya̱tanuvu̱nu nada, ta̱raju̱?” Tapi ti̱ta̱ju̱ nijya̱mi̱tya jchana̱tya̱da daryaju̱ variñi̱ Ju̱denu riva, jiryatiy mityamusiy su̱ndejada daryaju̱ ridyiya.
Daryaju̱yu vu̱yaju̱y vaatati̱numa vanu jiryatiy sami̱sa̱da jarapu̱yadamusiy.
Jesúsmu tuva̱chuvavyedabay va̱ta̱dara vanu̱tya̱da simusiy
Ru̱mu̱rya̱danumatiy nada Pyítruju̱be, Juánta, nadaya̱da ji̱ta variy yisa̱ vichavamyuju̱. Nanutu̱choda variy jasiy ruuva: “Caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱miy, rimyityumiy jarye jtesiy darya na̱dyiva.”
Rityuva̱chodanumatirya, riñiquenu̱yada ji̱ta ti̱tajuu sisa̱ Ju̱denu variy: “Nu̱jye̱, jiñi̱ Ji̱ta ju̱dejadara jarichu, mucadi jarye, ja̱mu na̱va jarye, vinu rani̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ rani̱cha yimusiy.
Ji jteda su̱tosiy jimyuchechiy, jiryatiy nu̱myunatyi̱ Davyíbeñi̱:

content.text: ¿Ta̱raju̱ra riñique̱ munu̱ñumiy, ta̱raju̱? ¿Ta̱raju̱ra rijechipiya̱ nijya̱nvay va̱cha, ta̱raju̱? tama̱ samirya rani̱cha, tama̱. Riyaro̱nu ji̱ta ma̱myi nutyityu̱miñi̱, curacaveda jarye jiyaro̱nuni̱ Ju̱denu, sajaryeti̱ jarye jiyaro̱nuyu.

content: Si̱tenu ji̱ta riyaro̱nuni̱ jidyenu Jesús. Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta jijeryeti̱ sami̱. Riyaro̱nu ji̱ta nutyityu̱vedani̱. Jeródes, Púnsiyu Pyidátu, munu̱ñujuu, Irayénuveda jarye jiyaro̱nuni̱.
Ruuto̱tanimya̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ varidyerya, jiryatiy jidyetyanu̱yada ta̱ridyerya.
Diye, Nu̱jye̱, ya̱jnu̱y nu̱tyuramu riyaro̱nu jiñiquejadata nu̱y. Ya̱vanu̱tyaniy nu̱y jimyuchechimyintyidye, nu̱ña̱tidye nique jichuvu̱yasa̱damura jiñiquejadantidye.
Ya̱jmu̱tya jijyomutu ratyasarata, ya̱tidye ju̱danu variy, ya̱tidye jvaantyirya mityamusiy datyadodantidye, ti̱ttasara risa̱ju̱, jidyenu jiintyasi̱musiy, jiryatiy Jesús jtyati̱ni̱.”

Ripyaru̱yadanumatiy riva Ju̱denujsa̱ tu̱choda, ramichutya̱da tara varirya roriy, jiryatiy riintye̱ryaniy ravimuyu. Samu̱chadeda Ju̱denu Jnutu variy ti̱ta̱ju̱ ruuvayu, riñiquejada ji̱ta jichuvu̱yasa̱damu varirya Ju̱denu niquejada.
Ru̱tañu̱yada ti̱ta̱ju̱musiy jiberyanchiy: “Vu̱beryanuma day”
Jiryatiy rityuva̱choda rajuuvay nijya̱nvay, vatajuu rijechipiya̱jada variy. Ne ti̱ niquenu̱yada: “Jirya raberya day.” Vatajuu riberyani̱ yitañu̱yada darya, ratiy vichanu̱yada ruumu.
Rityu̱chunu̱yada ji̱ta sansu̱byimiy jichuvu̱yasa̱damura Nutyityu̱ Jesús mi̱sa̱subeda. Rityi tuva̱chunu̱yada simu, samiy jvadichavay rivyichanu̱yada nijya̱nvajyu̱ variy.
Ne ti̱musiy rasu̱tyeñu̱yada tara; jiryatiy mucaditavay daryaju̱ rivyichanu̱yada, ritye̱ryu̱tya̱da varirya, riryoriy jarye jitye̱ryu̱tyanu̱yada risa̱ju̱, ramutimyu̱ ne rasu̱tyeñu̱yada tara ruumusiy.
Jiryatiy ru̱mutya̱nu̱yadara jiberya murichirya, ru̱tunu̱yada Jesús nusu̱byimimyuju̱ra, ribeñu̱yada variy rityuunura. Jadchiy ji̱ta riche̱ñu̱yada yivara daryatiy rivya̱ta day.

Darya ni̱day sivaañu̱yada Jusíberya. Tajiñuma ru̱teda nusu̱byimiy varidyerya si̱tya day, Bernabénuma ru̱teda varidyerya, jmu̱tya̱dacanuy su̱tacha̱da day. Devyíbe ju̱riiñuti̱, Chípyirye ra̱tyuumu vichi̱ variñi̱.
Ni̱ni̱ ta̱ryu̱tyanu̱yadara jimyucadi, su̱tunu̱yadara ramurichirya nusu̱chavajyu̱.
